title: Saudia Chicken Tacos
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired dish made with saudia chicken, smoky spices and crispy tacos.
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
Season the saudia chicken breast with smoky paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
Heat some oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the chopped onion until it's translucent.
Add the diced tomato to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Warm the flaky tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.

Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of the grilled chicken onto a tortilla, followed by some of the onion and tomato mixture, and finishing with a dollop of sour cream and some chopped cilantro.
Serve the tacos immediately and enjoy!
